title: 2348. Number of Zero-Filled Subarrays

examples.explanation: There are 4 occurrences of [0] as a subarray. There are 2 occurrences of [0,0] as a subarray. There is no occurrence of a subarray with a size more than 2 filled with 0. Therefore, we return 6.

There is no subarray filled with 0. Therefore, we return 0.
